backlog.title: Scaffold Phase 1 domain/services/repositories modules
backlog.description: Add empty domain/services/repositories submodules for tenants, api_keys, endpoints, and events with docstrings pinning the api → services → repositories → infra layering (domain imports nothing) before any Phase 1 code lands.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create tenants table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the tenants table (id, name, created_at, deleted_at) with `alembic upgrade head` verified locally against Postgres.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create api_keys table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the api_keys table (tenant_id FK, key_hash, key_prefix, scopes, revoked_at, created_at) with an index on key_prefix for fast lookup without a full-table scan.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create endpoints table
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the endpoints table (tenant_id FK, url, secret, subscribed_event_types, status, breaker_state, opened_at) per the plan's data model, hand-reviewed before merge.

backlog.title: Alembic migration: create events table with idempotency constraint
backlog.description: Autogenerate and hand-review a migration creating the events table (tenant_id FK, type, payload JSONB, idempotency_key, created_at) with a `UNIQUE(tenant_id, idempotency_key)` constraint enforced at the DB level.

backlog.title: Define Phase 1 domain entities
backlog.description: Define pure domain entities for Tenant, ApiKey, Endpoint, and Event as dataclasses/value objects with zero I/O and zero framework imports, expressing business rules (e.g. an ApiKey knows how to check its own scopes) independent of persistence or wire format.

backlog.title: Define Phase 1 ORM models
backlog.description: Define SQLAlchemy 2.0 mapped classes for Tenant, ApiKey, Endpoint, and Event matching the Phase 1 migrations, kept in the repositories layer and never imported by the domain or api layers.

backlog.title: Define Phase 1 Pydantic wire schemas
backlog.description: Define Pydantic request/response schemas for tenant, api-key, endpoint, and event payloads (create/update/read variants) in the api layer, mapped to/from domain entities at the boundary and never passed into services directly.

backlog.title: Implement TenantRepository and ApiKeyRepository
backlog.description: Implement TenantRepository and ApiKeyRepository over the async SQLAlchemy session, exposing create/get/list/revoke operations that return domain entities (never ORM objects) and support prefix-based API key lookup.

backlog.title: Implement EndpointRepository with keyset pagination
backlog.description: Implement EndpointRepository with create/get/update/delete/list operations returning domain entities, where list() accepts a cursor and limit and orders by a stable key for keyset pagination.

backlog.title: Implement EventRepository with idempotency conflict detection
backlog.description: Implement EventRepository with an insert operation that catches the `UNIQUE(tenant_id, idempotency_key)` DB violation and surfaces it as a typed domain conflict for the service layer to handle, rather than leaking a raw DB exception.

backlog.title: Implement unit-of-work for transaction boundaries
backlog.description: Implement a unit-of-work context manager wrapping the async SQLAlchemy session and repositories, giving each service use case a single commit/rollback boundary instead of ad hoc session handling scattered across services.

backlog.title: Implement API key hashing, prefix, and verification
backlog.description: Implement API key generation, salted hashing over the secret portion, prefix extraction, and constant-time verification as pure domain/infra logic, unit-tested against known vectors including tampered and truncated keys.

backlog.title: Implement API key issuance, rotation, and revocation service
backlog.description: Implement an ApiKeyService use case for issuing a new key for a tenant, rotating a key (revoke + issue atomically via the unit-of-work), and revoking a key, returning the plaintext key exactly once at issuance time only.

backlog.title: Implement auth dependency: key validation, scopes, tenant isolation
backlog.description: Implement a FastAPI dependency that extracts the API key from the request header, verifies its hash and revocation status, loads the owning tenant, enforces required scopes, and scopes all downstream queries to that tenant — rejecting missing/malformed/revoked keys with 401 before any handler code runs.

backlog.title: Implement EndpointService use cases
backlog.description: Implement an EndpointService with register/list/update/delete use cases (validating URL format and subscribed event types) operating purely on domain entities via the unit-of-work, with no FastAPI or SQLAlchemy imports.

backlog.title: Implement /v1/endpoints CRUD router
backlog.description: Implement the /v1/endpoints router (POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE) delegating entirely to EndpointService with no DB session or ORM import in the router module, converting between Pydantic schemas and domain entities at the boundary.

backlog.title: Implement cursor pagination utility
backlog.description: Implement an opaque, encoded cursor pagination helper (encode/decode keyset cursors) shared across list endpoints, replacing OFFSET-based paging, with unit tests covering forward paging and an invalid-cursor error case.

backlog.title: Wire cursor pagination into GET /v1/endpoints
backlog.description: Wire the cursor pagination helper into GET /v1/endpoints, returning `next_cursor`/`has_more` in the response envelope, covered by a test asserting stable ordering and no skipped/duplicated rows across pages.

backlog.title: Implement EventIngestService idempotency-key handling
backlog.description: Implement an EventIngestService use case that, given a tenant, event payload, and `Idempotency-Key`, returns the existing event unchanged if the key was seen before with an identical body, and raises a typed conflict if the key was seen before with a differing body.

backlog.title: Implement POST /v1/events ingest router
backlog.description: Implement POST /v1/events delegating to EventIngestService, returning `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header pointing at the created event, and translating the idempotency conflict into the shared problem+json error envelope.

backlog.title: Implement RFC 9457 exception hierarchy and central handler
backlog.description: Implement the internal exception hierarchy and a central FastAPI exception handler mapping all raised exceptions to RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` responses with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, and `trace_id` fields, never leaking a stack trace across the wire.

backlog.title: Normalize Pydantic 422s into the problem+json envelope
backlog.description: Override FastAPI's default RequestValidationError handling so Pydantic 422s are normalized into the same problem+json envelope used by the rest of the API, with field-level errors under `detail` and no framework-default error shape leaking through.

backlog.title: Add trace_id middleware for requests and errors
backlog.description: Add middleware that generates (or propagates an inbound) trace/correlation ID per request, attaches it to structured logs for that request, and includes it in every problem+json error response so a user can quote it back.

backlog.title: Add OpenAPI examples and auth scheme docs
backlog.description: Add request/response examples and a documented API-key auth security scheme to every Phase 1 v1 endpoint's OpenAPI metadata, including the full set of problem+json error response shapes per endpoint.

backlog.title: CI job: OpenAPI spec drift check
backlog.description: Add a CI step that generates the OpenAPI spec from the running app, diffs it against a committed spec file under docs/, and fails the build on drift, with a Makefile target to regenerate the committed spec locally.

backlog.title: Extend import-linter contract for Phase 1 modules
backlog.description: Extend the import-linter contract to cover the new tenants/api_keys/endpoints/events modules across api/services/domain/repositories, and verify a deliberately forbidden import (repositories importing from domain) fails the contract.

backlog.title: Add testcontainers Postgres fixture for integration suite
backlog.description: Add a testcontainers-managed real Postgres fixture for tests/integration (container-scoped, schema applied via `alembic upgrade head`, transactional rollback per test), reusing the Phase 0 Redis client wiring with no stream logic, and confirm no SQLite or mocked DB appears anywhere in the suite.

backlog.title: Add polyfactory factories for Phase 1 entities
backlog.description: Add polyfactory factories for Tenant, ApiKey, Endpoint, and Event domain entities so integration tests can generate realistic test data without hand-rolled fixtures.

backlog.title: Integration test: idempotency key dedup
backlog.description: Add an integration test proving a duplicate POST /v1/events with the same `Idempotency-Key` and identical body returns the original event with no second row inserted, covering Testing scenario #5 against real Postgres.

backlog.title: Integration test: 409 on differing body for reused key
backlog.description: Add an integration test proving POST /v1/events with a reused `Idempotency-Key` but a differing body returns `409` via the problem+json envelope, covering Testing scenario #6 against real Postgres.

backlog.title: Integration test: revoked/malformed key and tenant isolation
backlog.description: Add integration tests proving a revoked or malformed API key is rejected with `401`, and that a valid key belonging to tenant A cannot read or modify tenant B's endpoints or events, covering Testing scenario #12 against real Postgres.

backlog.title: Write ADR: Phase 1 API and domain decisions
backlog.description: Write docs/adr/0002-phase-1-api-domain.md capturing the Phase 1 decisions (three-model-set layering, idempotency-key conflict semantics, cursor vs offset pagination, API key hashing scheme) with alternatives considered and the tradeoff accepted for each.

backlog.title: Update docs/failure-modes.md with Phase 1 rows
backlog.description: Add Phase 1 rows to docs/failure-modes.md (duplicate idempotency key, differing-body idempotency conflict, revoked/malformed API key, cross-tenant access attempt), each naming the expected behavior and the test that proves it.
